name: Worlds
purpose: Verify state continuity, invariants, multi-seed behavior, resource use, novelty disclosure and rollback.

baseline_claims.need: A seed and action stream reproduce the inspected state.
Declared ecological, economic and gameplay invariants survive multiple seeds.
Snapshots, migration and rollback preserve world lineage.
Unscored new structures are disclosed rather than silently passed.
The world remains viable under declared player pressure models.
Simulation pace, memory and heat fit the available machine body.
